bullets.content: [general] REPEATED 3x: misquoted solve limit (16; tasks say 4). First line of every task: copy LIMITS sentence verbatim ('at most 4 times' -> 'solve budget = 4'); number solves k/4. Plan S1 control, S2 judge/variant, S3 one-factor variant, S4 confirm best. Never exceed. Self note saying 16 is wrong.

[general] Budget solves before the first mesh. One factor per solve so compare() attributes the difference; group factors only if a judge already ranks them. Never mesh after the last solve. Avoid near-identical variants. Extra solves don't fix diffuse error.

[general] After EVERY mesh read 'element size near' per group. After EVERY solve checklist: view(error, iso), copy top-5 hotspots (coords, local h, share), compare(prev,this), table row. If hotspot h >1.5x requested, refinement failed: cover with box/larger radius or drop.
[general] Always end with explicit submit(best solve by estimated A/c), not the last solve. g5 submitted last solve (0.502) over S3 (est ~0.69); previously S6 over S5 lost ~0.007.

[general] Before submit write one line per candidate: DOFs, diff, e=calib x diff, g=auto_e/e, A=(g/2)^2 (g<2) or g/2, c=DOFs/auto_DOFs, A/c. Submit the argmax. Name binding term (field vs check-point RMS); if field <~8% points may bind.
[general] Above 2x gain score is cost-limited: ~1/(e*N), +44% DOFs needs >31% lower error. Tied candidates: submit the cheapest. Use a judge at ~2x DOFs for compare() only.
[general] Never build a mesh you will not solve. If a solve remains, solve the judge mesh and run compare(candidate, judge) before submit.

[general] Below target (g<2) score ~ e^-2/N: a refinement pays iff local rate p=ln(e1/e2)/ln(N2/N1) > 0.5 (above target p>1). Measure p per single-factor pair: belt box p~0.58 pays, f2 group vs edge 40 p~0.83 pays. If global p<0.5 submit cheapest sensible mesh.
[general] When DOFs stop responding to global h (features set cost), pick the h that protects check points and spend effort on refinement placement.

[general] When top hotspots each hold <5% the error is diffuse. Use boxes over hot bands with coarser background; coarsen black regions. Once gain exceeds 2, uniform refinement only breaks even or loses.

[general] Group refinement reaches only ~0.6x radius. Edge refinements failed on two tasks. Boxes realise ~1.35x request: ask ~0.75x; a box size >=0.7x realised h adds almost nothing (check mesh() node delta vs control; bc0 +35 nodes). Thin slab boxes at hotspots.
[general] Read compare() 'regions' nearest_reentrant_edge. If hotspot <3 mm from a re-entrant edge, refine that edge, not the nearest face group (g6: edge 40 at 1.6-2.0 mm).
[general] When a refinement closes one pocket (belt 32% -> 2-3% per cell), re-rank pockets from the new error map before next variant; clamp became top pocket yet two solves still went to belt.
[general] Calibrate compare() per task from scored truth: bc0 true field = 1.25x diff to 30k judge (9.27/7.42); low calibration predicted 0.75 vs actual 0.686.

[general] After every variant solve check top hotspots' local h dropped below control's; if not, refinement missed, don't submit it. Avoid near-identical variants; choose bolder changes on different regions.
[general] Displacement FE strain energy rises toward the converged value as mesh refines; shrinking increments mean convergence, not a singularity artifact.
[general] Every refinement must name a target (group, box, edge or point); one without was ignored. Check reported size near the group, quality.min >= 0.1, folded_cells = 0.
[general] Rank refinements by measured energy gain per DOF (dU/dDOF) from single-factor solves, not intuition; the region you think over-resolved can be the best investment.

[general] Judge check-point-targeted refinements with compare(control, variant): read where VM changed. Before submit check reaction vs load. Spend solves on bolder experiments, not 0.0004 size tweaks on near-ties.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Teacher's next mesh: control plus {edge 40, 0.0025, r0.004}. Clamp band z 0.0555-0.057 holds ~16% error (4 cells, 210-260%, r 0.0145-0.015, 1.6-2 mm from edge 40, h 0.0041). Pays if diff <=13.4% at <=25.5k DOFs. Optional ring box [-0.017,-0.017,0.050,0.017,0.017,0.059] 0.003 r0.002.
[abc_00000003_bc7] AVOID f2 group 0.002 r0.006: +1.9k DOFs, diff 14.6->14.4% (p 0.17); clamp hotspots 4-5 mm below f2, spill refines black top disk f25.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Belt box settled at z 0.0165-0.032: bottom 0.020->0.0165 paid (p~1.1); bottom 0.011 (p 0.30), top 0.0345 (p 0.15) did not. Do not widen; belt cells 2.2-3.1% each.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Ablation (one solve): control minus edges 8/39 (belt box covers junction; hotspots on f23 bore flanks ~2 mm from f20). Break-even: -2k DOFs allows diff up to ~14.6%.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Never drop the belt box: without it (S6, 17.2k) ring z 0.020-0.031 held ~32% of error, hotspots h 0.0052, field 19.6%. With it est 17.4%, local p~0.58. (Self saw S6 score 0.233; belt boxes at +7k DOFs bought 1-3%, but teacher's calibrated S5 is higher.)
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Score flat ~0.22-0.23 from 17k-25k DOFs (p~0.49). Only p>0.5 moves pay: +8.5% DOFs needs >=4% relative cut in e. Compute p vs control for every variant.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp: f2 group 0.0025 r0.005 beats edge 40 (0.002 r0.007, est 20.5%) and thin box z 0.0535-0.0585 0.0028 (24.6k, est 17.1%, ~0.215). Keep f2 as only clamp refinement (clamp cells ~11.6%, acceptable). Thin 0.0035 r0.0015 box (~2k DOFs) only as a tested add-on.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Mid-height cells z 0.0255 (x ±0.0174, y ±0.013) hold 2.5-3% each at h 0.0039, 110-190% local error. Uniform 0.004 doesn't resolve; 2.5 mm wall limits grading.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Measured: top box 0.002 r0.003 cut est error 16.4%->~10.5% for +19.5k DOFs (score ~0.17); four ring boxes 0.0022 + f2 ~15.4% at 31.1k (~0.20). Two side boxes instead of junction box raised diff 12.6%->16.1%.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] AVOID changing h, f2 and box at once (h 0.0075, f2 0.003 r0.004, box 0.0032: ~20% at 18.6k, 0.20). Avoid uniform h 0.0035/0.0042 (flat or worse). Never box above z 0.0585 or below 0.0535 thin clamp (full-height box 32.2k DOFs, ~0.19).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Top disk f25 and stub ends f15/f16/f17/f5/f6 are error-free; coarsen them (coarse background, smaller bleed radii) to free DOFs. Don't refine f25 beyond r<=0.002 above z 0.059.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Hidden worst check point near f3 at x 0.029, z 0.026 (68% local error, h 0.004). Option: box [0.024,-0.010,0.020,0.031,0.010,0.034] 0.0033 only if points bind (they currently don't).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] AVOID global h >0.007 (0.0095 gave quality 0.066; 0.007 saved 8.6% DOFs but diff rose 15.1%->17%) or <0.005. Keep h 0.006; keep body bottom z 0-0.062 not too coarse (~7% error); if bottom cells >3% add box 0.0045.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Wall f23-f20 is ~2.5 mm: sizes >=0.0032 give <1 quadratic element across; two layers cost ~4x DOFs. Grade in-plane only; no sub-0.003 boxes over large wall areas.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Setup verified, reuse verbatim: 3d, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, fixed f2, 4e6 Pa f23, 2.1e6 Pa f16, no gravity. Record f2 reaction in S1 (expect ~0 N, closed bores); skipped last run.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Calibration: true field = 1.20 x diff to 53.5k judge (S4 16.8/14.0; earlier 1.16). Judge: h 0.0032, {edge 40,0.0014,r0.006}, {edge 39,0.0016,r0.005}, {edge 8,0.0016,r0.005}, {edge 3,0.0018,r0.004}. S1 control, S2 judge, S3/S4 variants.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Points don't bind (RMS 6.3% vs field 16.8%; hidden worst ~11% near f3 x 0.029, z 0.026 / stub junctions). Every DOF should lower field energy at edge-40 clamp corner or f23 bore flanks.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Keep order 2: error is smooth diffuse wall bending; DOF placement is the lever.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] After solve 1 view(error, iso) and (error, -x), list hotspot z-bands before choosing refinements.

[abc_00000065_bc0] LIMITS: 'You may call solve at most 4 times.' Write 'solve budget = 4' before inspect_geometry. Plan: S1 control, S2 trimmed root box, S3 trimmed at 0.0019, S4 best. Wrote 16 three generations running.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Teacher next mesh: control with root box trimmed to [0.015,-0.0115,-0.0085,0.03,0.0135,-0.0055] 0.0021 r0.003 (hotspots x 18.5-26.6, y -6.2..8), ~1.5-3k fewer DOFs at equal error. Second: trimmed at 0.0019 (not below 0.0018). Keep if g/(2c) beats.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Top hotspots at z -7 mm inside f5 (x 18-20) and f7 (x 25-27), y -10..8; root realises h 0.0028-0.0031 under 0.0021 request. Cell (0.0152,0.0014,-0.006) holds 13.6% with 24 elements: test root box x down to 0.010 at 0.0023. Box y must reach 0.020 unless trim tests pass.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Marginal value: root box 4.8e-10 J/DOF, upper box 0.0035->0.0027 2.3e-10, y+ box 0.9e-10. Spend DOFs at f5/f7 root first. Root box not above 0.0024 (0.0028 lost 0.14% U).
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Box 0.0018 realises ~0.0024; never request 0.0015 or 0.0011 (score -0.48 vs 0.56; quality 0.109). Keep box >=0.0018, folded_cells=0.
